name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: P0 identity normalization fix.2: every API-driven Group scan with sourceRow now normalizes the exact QUET NHOM source row even when Facebook keeps the same numeric Group key.
resolvedScanGroupKey uses canonical fileGroupKey when available and falls back to the original sourceGroupKey; numeric-to-slug and numeric-to-numeric scans share the same source-row path.
The hotfix preserves target count, pagination/cursor logic, exact-batch AUTO AI attribution, Lead Qualification Hard Gate, and manual JSON fallback behavior.

P0 identity/upsert hotfix: API Group scans now bind canonical vanity slug identity back to the exact QUET NHOM source row instead of appending a duplicate row when the input URL uses a numeric Group ID.
Scan source metadata (source row, source URL, source key) is carried into import for API-driven scans; manual JSON import keeps the legacy fallback registration behavior.
Source-row binding is fail-closed and preserves operator-selected target count, existing non-placeholder group name, formulas, pagination behavior, and Lead Qualification Hard Gate.
Lead Qualification Hard Gate separates need detection from actual sales qualification.
PASS requires Buyer Role=Co, Product Fit=Co and deterministic score >=65; FAIL/WATCH never enter KH PASS counters.
Score components: Need 25 + Product Fit 25 + Action 20 + Urgency 15 + Reachability 10 + Freshness 5.
Per-Group AI Context / Offer in QUET NHOM is the primary Product Fit context; global Business Context is fallback. With no effective context, Product Fit is forced to Chua ro.
AUTO AI is batch-bound: it analyzes only exact Source IDs newly imported by the current Group scan, preventing old waiting rows from leaking into the run.
MANUAL AI can analyze the exact last scan, checked Groups, selected CO HOI rows, all waiting sources, or legacy rows requiring Hard Gate requalification.
Manual JSON import is fallback ingestion and does not auto-run AI.
KHACH HANG TIEM NANG preserves old rows as LEGACY until all known sources for that person are requalified; PASS metrics exclude LEGACY.
Operator bootstrap menu is simplified to Settings, Scan Group, AI Analysis, Refresh Data (when needed), with diagnostics/import/dedupe/version moved under tools/system.
